artifacts.summary: Added a dropped-pathspec ledger and a new V6 refusal gate (exit 4) to git-commit-scoped.sh so a partial pathspec drop whose survivors carry no diff is no longer indistinguishable from a benign no-op; pinned with T11/T12/T13 and documented in git-staging-scope.md.

completion_data.completion_summary: Closed the residual false-success path in git-commit-scoped.sh: added a dropped-pathspec ledger to the V2 classification loop and a new V6 refusal gate (exit code 4, loud ERROR naming every dropped path) that fires only when a pathspec was dropped AND no commit was produced, leaving every all-resolve caller byte-identical. Pinned with three new regression cases (T11/T12/T13) and documented the full exit-code/gate contract plus the recorded caller-escalation residual in git-staging-scope.md.

memory_candidates.content: To manually reproduce behavior of a script gated by deploy-root-guard.sh (which refuses to run outside a deployed .claude/scripts/ or .opencode/scripts/ tree) in a throwaway mktemp -d scratch repo: copy the target script PLUS its runtime dependencies (deploy-root-guard.sh, task-lock.sh, lib/common.sh, and any lib/*.sh it sources) into <scratch>/.claude/scripts/[lib/], then invoke the copy at that path (not the source-store original). This makes PROJECT_ROOT resolve to the scratch repo and the deploy-root-guard '*/.claude' case match, so the manual repro exercises the real guarded code path rather than being refused outright or mocked.
